name: Continue_ScreenTask
notes: Draws CONTINUE 0x22C + digit every frame it runs, incl. the frame a player continues (then 0x009C90A4 = 2, 0x004141D0(0/1)); 0x009A2BB8 is NOT reset on a continue. Port: WorldHud::continueShown; world_test auto_st3 CONTINUE sprites 600/600

name: Player_ContinueTask
notes: Per-player CONTINUE 0x00416880/0x004168C0 at 0x004143A5 only if not joined, not expired, mode 6, game type not 2/3, Credit_CanContinue, 0x009C90A4 != 4; count after -0x2D. Port: WorldHud::Player::continueShown; 2p_continue 274/274

name: g_continueCount
notes: Global CONTINUE countdown (0x9FFF, -0x2D per frame); keeps its value after a continue (only 0x004604E0 / a credit change reset it)

name: Actor31_Beh8Wait

name: Actor31_Beh11Fall
notes: Behaviour 11: off the edge of the surface: +0x1388 = start y, motion 0x3A5 (0x1BC skeleton 0x17), gravity 0xBD5F0123 to the floor (0x00409D40), landing motion by drop (>15: 0x3A5/0x1BC, >10: 0x3A9/0x1BA), then 7 / 10 (flag 0x20000000), material 0x5A or dead: 3 (skeleton 0x16) / 0x0044D0A0

name: Actor31_Beh17Recover
